result.instructions: Tools for Zettle, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What did my shop sell yesterday, and how much was refunded?"; "Which products are running low on stock in my store?"; "How much is in my Zettle account and when is the next payout?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zettle data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zettle_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zettle_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zettle_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. zettle_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zettle_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Zettle user and organization this API key belongs to (uuid, organizationUuid). GET oauth.zettle.com/users/self.

tools.name: zettle_list_purchases
tools.title: List purchases
tools.description: List POS purchases (sales and refunds) with amount, currency, timestamp, products, discounts, payments, refund info and the cashier. Needs READ:PURCHASE. Amounts are in the smallest currency unit. Default window is the last 3 years. Page with next_page_hash (pass it back as last_purchase_hash with the same other arguments). GET /purchases/v2.

start_date.description: Only purchases from this UTC date or date-time on (inclusive), e.g. 2026-10-01.

end_date.description: Only purchases before this UTC date or date-time (exclusive), e.g. 2026-10-08.

descending.description: true = most recent first (default false: oldest first).

last_purchase_hash.description: next_page_hash of the previous reply, for the next page.

tools.name: zettle_get_purchase
tools.title: Get purchase
tools.description: One purchase (sale or refund) in full by its purchase UUID (the purchaseUUID1 field of zettle_list_purchases; the older short purchaseUUID is deprecated and not accepted): line items, VAT, payments, refund links. Needs READ:PURCHASE. GET /purchase/v2/{purchaseUuid}.

purchase_uuid.description: Purchase UUID: the purchaseUUID1 field (a UUID such as 589c2de6-3ee4-11eb-9e70-a2ac075b17fd).

tools.name: zettle_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products in the POS product library with variants (SKU, barcode, price, cost price, VAT), category, online status and ETag. Zettle returns the whole library at once; this tool slices it with limit/offset and filters by name. Needs READ:PRODUCT. Prices are in the smallest currency unit. GET /organizations/self/products/v2.

name_contains.description: Only products whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

offset.description: Products to skip (default 0). Use next_offset of the previous reply.

tools.name: zettle_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by UUID with all variants, prices, VAT, category, images and online-store data. Needs READ:PRODUCT. GET /organizations/self/products/{productUuid}.

tools.name: zettle_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the product categories (uuid, name). Needs READ:PRODUCT. GET /organizations/self/categories/v2.

tools.name: zettle_get_library
tools.title: Get product library with discounts
tools.description: The product library together with its discounts (name, amount or percentage), paginated. Returns products, discounts and next_offset (pass it back as offset). Needs READ:PRODUCT. GET /organizations/self/library.

offset.description: Position to start from (default 0); use next_offset of the previous reply.

tools.name: zettle_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: WRITE: add a new product to the Zettle product library (it appears in the POS and, if enabled, the online store). Not idempotent: calling twice creates two products. Needs READ:PRODUCT and WRITE:PRODUCT. vat_percentage must be one of the VAT rates enabled in the merchant's Zettle settings. Prices are in the smallest currency unit. POST /organizations/self/products.

vat_percentage.description: VAT percent, e.g. 25. Must match a rate set in the merchant's Zettle account.

price.description: Selling price in the smallest currency unit (omit for a product priced at the till).

cost_price.description: Cost price in the smallest currency unit.

currency.description: Currency of price and cost_price; required when either is set (e.g. SEK, GBP, EUR).

variants.description: 1-99 variants (a product without options has one).

tools.name: zettle_list_inventories
tools.title: List inventories (stock locations)
tools.description: List the stock locations (inventories): inventoryUuid, name, type (STORE, SOLD, SUPPLIER, BIN) and which is the default. Use the STORE inventoryUuid with zettle_get_stock. Needs READ:PRODUCT. GET /v3/inventories.

tools.name: zettle_get_stock
tools.title: Get stock balances
tools.description: Stock balances per product variant (balance, low-stock level and alert, last update). With inventory_uuid: that STORE inventory only; without: all stores. Only products with inventory tracking enabled appear. Needs READ:PRODUCT. Page with next_cursor. GET /v3/stock or /v3/stock/{inventoryUuid}.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous reply, for the next page.

tools.name: zettle_get_stock_for_products
tools.title: Get stock for products
tools.description: Stock balances of a few specific products in one inventory (read-only lookup, nothing is changed). Needs READ:PRODUCT. Page with next_cursor (send the same product_uuids again). POST /v3/stock/{inventoryUuid}/products with the product UUIDs.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous reply, for the next page.

tools.name: zettle_get_account_balance
tools.title: Get account balance
tools.description: The merchant's Zettle account balance (totalBalance in the smallest currency unit, currencyId). LIQUID = money available for payout; PRELIMINARY = payments not yet settled. Optional point in time. Needs READ:FINANCE. GET /v2/accounts/{LIQUID|PRELIMINARY}/balance.

account.description: LIQUID (available for payout) or PRELIMINARY (not yet settled).

at.description: Balance as of this UTC date-time (default now).

tools.name: zettle_list_account_transactions
tools.title: List account transactions
tools.description: Transactions (payments, fees, payouts, adjustments) in the LIQUID or PRELIMINARY account between start and end (end exclusive), with timestamp, amount (smallest currency unit, can be negative), type and originating transaction UUID. Needs READ:FINANCE. Page with next_offset. GET /v2/accounts/{account}/transactions.

start.description: Start, UTC date or date-time (inclusive), e.g. 2026-10-01.

end.description: End, UTC date or date-time (exclusive), e.g. 2026-11-01.

tools.name: zettle_get_payout_info
tools.title: Get payout info
tools.description: Payout information of the LIQUID account: totalBalance, currencyId, nextPayoutAmount, discountRemaining and payout periodicity. Needs READ:FINANCE. GET /v2/payout-info.

at.description: As of this UTC date-time (default now).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Zettle
prompts.description: What you can do with Zettle here, with example requests to try.
